f3_program: observe(at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.length", "current"), 3, "mile", source("road stretching 3 miles from the base camp to the chain challenge"))
observe(at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.interval_count", "current"), 1, "count", source("a car comes down the road from the base camp towards the chain challenge"))
observe(at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.interval_duration", "current"), 20, "minute", source("Every 20 minutes"))

quotient_relation(at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.rate", "current"), at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.interval_count", "current"), at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.interval_duration", "current"), source("Every 20 minutes, a car comes down the road from the base camp towards the chain challenge"))
observe(at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.count", "target"), 30, "count", source("once 30 cars have come down the road"))

rate_relation(at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.count", "target"), at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.rate", "current"), at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.elapsed_time_hours", "target"), source("Every 20 minutes, a car comes down the road from the base camp towards the chain challenge"))
query("value", at("base_camp_to_chain_challenge_road.car_flow.elapsed_time_hours", "target"))
assumptions: The singular phrase "a car" denotes one car in each stated 20-minute interval.
F3-v1 has no allowlisted terminal query for a mean or average; mean_relation is limited to source-stated relations, so this intent cannot be represented without adding a question-derived calculation.

f3_program: observe(at("kimberly.bottle.water.volume", "initial"), 4, "liter", source("a 4-liter bottle full of water"))
consume("e1", "kimberly", at("kimberly.bottle.water.volume", "current"), fraction(at("kimberly.bottle.water.volume", "current"), 1, 4), source("she consumed a quarter of the water in the bottle"))
consume("e2", "kimberly", at("kimberly.bottle.water.volume", "current"), fraction(at("kimberly.bottle.water.volume", "current"), 2, 3), source("she drank 2/3rd of the remaining water"))
query("value", at("kimberly.bottle.water.volume", "current"))
assumptions: A bottle described as both 4-liter and full contains 4 liters of water initially.
Each consumption applies to the current water volume in narrative order.

f3_program: observe(at("company.restaurant_leases.ground.expiring_count", "2020-2024"), 381, "count", cell("2020 – 2024", "Ground Leases"))
observe(at("company.restaurant_leases.ground.expiring_count", "2025-2029"), 198, "count", cell("2025 – 2029", "Ground Leases"))
query("absolute_difference", at("company.restaurant_leases.ground.expiring_count", "2020-2024"), at("company.restaurant_leases.ground.expiring_count", "2025-2029"))
assumptions: The phrase "difference ... between" denotes an unordered absolute difference because the question specifies no direction.

f3_program: observe(at("factory.cars.doors_per_car", "current"), 5, "door_per_car", source("cars with 5 doors"))
observe(at("factory.car_production.count", "initial"), 200, "count", source("planning to produce 200 cars"))
remove("e1", "factory", at("factory.car_production.count", "current"), 50, source("they decreased the production by 50 cars"))
remove("e2", "factory", at("factory.car_production.count", "current"), fraction(at("factory.car_production.count", "current"), 50, 100), source("they also had to cut production by another 50%"))

product_relation(at("factory.door_production.count", "current"), at("factory.car_production.count", "current"), at("factory.cars.doors_per_car", "current"), source("A factory manufactures cars with 5 doors"))
query("value", at("factory.door_production.count", "current"))
assumptions: The second percentage cut applies to the production level remaining after the earlier 50-car decrease.
The phrase "cars with 5 doors" denotes five doors per produced car.
